findings.detail: 9 captcha image-driver cases (TestGenerate_/TestSaveAndVerify_/TestVerify_..._WithTolerance for Slide, Click and Rotate) fail with 'graph image is invalid', 'freetype: DrawText called with a nil font' or 'no image': go-captcha/v2 v2.0.5 requires the caller to supply background images and a truetype font from disk (see its own tests/base.go, which reads files from paths the module zip does not contain) and the upstream tests never do. TestECDHCrypto_EncryptAndVerify builds two independent ECDHCrypto instances and expects the second keypair to verify the first one's output. Both proofs are reproduced offline against byte-identical copies of the module cache (T04-pristine-transcripts.json, T04-upstream-red.json): the placed packages fail exactly the same 14 captcha and 1 password cases in the same order, and pass the same 39 and 10.

findings.detail: enttest.NewQuotaPGClient truncates the quota catalog on every construction, so a shared stale lab makes unrelated quota cases fail. The first differential runs without -p 1 showed failures moving between runs; a further lab-reset bug (skipping sql/gpu/ops/task_roles.sql because its CREATE ROLE is not idempotent also dropped the database ACL) produced a false TestQuotaGpuRestrictedRoleAndExplicitIsolation failure until the REVOKE/GRANT pair was re-applied. After those fixes both trees report exactly the same 602 test statuses.
findings.title: lab re-provisioning and -p 1 are prerequisites, not options
